description.value: Jam Café is a beloved West Coast breakfast and brunch chain that has been serving comfort food since 2012, with its Kitsilano outpost sitting on West 4th Avenue — one of Vancouver's most popular cycling corridors. The menu leans Southern-inspired, with crowd favourites like Fried Chicken French Toast, fluffy three-stack pancakes, and the hearty Charlie Bowl, all made with locally sourced ingredients. The cozy, vintage-eclectic interior and signature cocktails (mimosas, bacon Caesars) make it a natural rest stop for cyclists exploring the Kitsilano neighbourhood.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record points to the Kitsilano location at 2153 West 4th Avenue; the website's /contact-us/ page confirms this address as 'Vancouver - Kitsilano: 2153 West 4th Avenue, Vancouver, BC V6K 1N7' with phone 604-423-3350, matching OSM exactly. Takeout is confirmed by the website phrase 'All Jam Cafe Locations are open for indoor dining and take out service!' No bike parking, water refill, washroom, or other cycling amenities are mentioned anywhere in the fetched website content.
concerns: Website represents a multi-location chain (Victoria, Beatty Street, Kitsilano, Lonsdale); the OSM record and this listing pertain only to the Kitsilano location — ensure no duplicate OSM records exist for other locations in the same directory intake.
OSM address lacked postal code; website /contact-us/ page supplies V6K 1N7 for this location, which has been used in the address field.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Jam Café Kitsilano is a well-established, active business on a high-traffic cycling street, making it a natural candidate for the directory. However, none of the three required criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence, so field verification is needed before listing.
